## Core Services Offered
1. **Roof Repair** — Emergency and scheduled roof repair for leaks, storm damage, hail damage, wind damage. Same-day emergency service available.
2. **Roof Replacement** — Complete roof replacement using GAF and Owens Corning materials. Full tear-off, synthetic underlayment, new flashing, ridge vents.
3. **Residential Roofing** — Asphalt shingle, metal, tile, slate roofing for homes.
4. **Commercial Roofing** — TPO, flat, and pitched roofing systems for commercial buildings.
5. **Storm Damage Restoration** — Emergency tarping, debris removal, full restoration. Insurance claim assistance provided.
6. **Siding Installation & Repair** — James Hardie fiber cement, LP SmartSide, vinyl siding.
7. **Gutter Installation & Repair** — Seamless aluminum gutters, gutter guards, downspouts.
8. **Window Replacement** — Energy-efficient double-pane, triple-pane, impact-resistant windows.
